# design-only-idea

Kind: non-Git idea workspace.
The built workspace contains only `design.md`.
The seed is an approved design for a new project with no vision, glossary, architecture document or verification kit.
It holds two core stories and one other story, each with acceptance cases, and two measurable non-functional targets.
Serves the plan skill's new-idea acceptance cases as input for the builder check and the story map.
`node sanity.mjs <built-folder>` requires Node 24 or later and checks the stories, targets and absence of Git.
